name: IR & Low-Light Awareness
description: Active IR illuminators used by security cameras are invisible to the naked eye but detectable with any IR-sensitive camera or monocular. Knowing which cameras are IR-enabled and the radius of their IR illumination allows an operator to avoid areas where they would be visible on IR-enhanced footage even in apparent darkness. An infrared monocular during pre-entry assessment reveals the full IR illumination map of the approach path.

blue.det: IR illuminator detection requires IR-sensitive camera; operator using IR viewer is not visible to the naked eye.
blue.cm: Regular camera maintenance ensuring IR illuminators function; conduct nighttime security walks; IR-opaque barriers for sensitive equipment and areas.
